text.tspan: What happens during helm upgrade, in order
Any step fails → the new revision is marked failed
--rollback-on-failure → apply the last deployed revision again (on install: uninstall)
helm.sh/hook: pre-install, pre-upgrade, post-upgrade, pre-delete, test …
helm.sh/hook-output-log-policy: prints the hook's logs in helm's output
--wait omitted = hookOnly: pods are NOT waited for
--wait alone = watcher: waits until every object is ready
crds/ folder: installed on first install only, never upgraded or deleted
helm.sh/resource-policy: keep → never deleted by Helm
